rules.name: Untrusted device is unverified
rules.description: An UNTRUSTED device signature means the device cannot be verified.
rules.explanation: The device trust signature is UNTRUSTED, so the device is treated as unverified.

rules.name: Unknown device is unverified
rules.description: An UNKNOWN device signature means the device cannot be verified.
rules.explanation: The device trust signature is UNKNOWN, so the device is treated as unverified.

rules.name: New device ID is unverified
rules.description: A device ID never seen for this user cannot be verified against history.
rules.explanation: The device ID is not among the user's known devices, so it is treated as unverified.

rules.name: High amount is elevated value
rules.description: A payment above the high-value threshold is an elevated-value transaction.
rules.explanation: The amount reaches the high-value threshold, so the transaction value is elevated.

rules.name: Amount spike is elevated value
rules.description: An amount far above the user's average is an elevated-value transaction.
rules.explanation: The amount is a large multiple of the user's average, so the transaction value is elevated.

rules.name: Suspicious login is an authentication anomaly
rules.description: Suspicious or high-risk login behaviour is an authentication anomaly.
rules.explanation: Login behaviour was flagged suspicious, which is an authentication anomaly.

rules.name: Failed logins are an authentication anomaly
rules.description: A failed-login pattern preceding a payment is an authentication anomaly.
rules.explanation: Failed login attempts were observed, which is an authentication anomaly.

rules.name: Unusual login is an authentication anomaly
rules.description: Unusual login behaviour is a weak authentication anomaly.
rules.explanation: Login behaviour was unusual, which is an authentication anomaly.

rules.name: Dormant account is an account anomaly
rules.description: Sudden use of a dormant account is an account lifecycle anomaly.
rules.explanation: The account was dormant, which is an account anomaly.

rules.name: Reactivated account is an account anomaly
rules.description: A recently reactivated account is an account lifecycle anomaly.
rules.explanation: The account was recently reactivated, which is an account anomaly.

rules.name: Suspicious account activity is an account anomaly
rules.description: Suspicious or unusual account activity is an account anomaly.
rules.explanation: The account activity history is suspicious or unusual, which is an account anomaly.

rules.name: Night transaction is off-hours activity
rules.description: A transaction between 00:00 and 05:59 is off-hours activity.
rules.explanation: The transaction occurred during the night window, which is off-hours activity.

rules.name: Unusual hour is off-hours activity
rules.description: A transaction outside the user's usual hours is off-hours activity.
rules.explanation: The transaction hour is outside the user's usual hours, which is off-hours activity.

rules.name: Unverified device
rules.description: Payments from an unverified device warrant step-up authentication.
rules.explanation: An unverified device alone raises the risk to MEDIUM.

rules.name: New geographic location
rules.description: A payment from a location the user has never used warrants step-up authentication.
rules.explanation: A new geographic location alone raises the risk to MEDIUM.

rules.name: Authentication anomaly
rules.description: Anomalous login behaviour weakens confidence in the session.
rules.explanation: An authentication anomaly alone raises the risk to MEDIUM.

rules.name: Account anomaly
rules.description: Account lifecycle anomalies are common in account-takeover and mule scenarios.
rules.explanation: An account anomaly alone raises the risk to MEDIUM.

rules.name: Elevated transaction value
rules.description: High-value payments warrant additional identity verification.
rules.explanation: An elevated transaction value alone raises the risk to MEDIUM.

rules.name: Night-time burst of transactions
rules.description: Rapid payments outside normal hours indicate automated or hurried activity. Neither factor alone is treated as risky.
rules.explanation: Off-hours activity combined with high transaction frequency raises the risk to MEDIUM.

rules.name: High amount from unverified device
rules.description: A high-value payment from an unverified device is a classic account-takeover pattern.
rules.explanation: A high amount combined with an unverified device raises the risk to HIGH.

rules.name: Authentication anomaly from new location
rules.description: Anomalous login behaviour combined with a new location suggests credential misuse.
rules.explanation: An authentication anomaly combined with a new location raises the risk to HIGH.

rules.name: Unverified device in new location
rules.description: A device and a location that are both unfamiliar suggest the session is not the genuine user.
rules.explanation: An unverified device in a new location raises the risk to HIGH.

rules.name: Elevated value with authentication anomaly
rules.description: Large payments after anomalous authentication are high-impact fraud candidates.
rules.explanation: An elevated value combined with an authentication anomaly raises the risk to HIGH.

rules.name: Elevated value on anomalous account
rules.description: A dormant or reactivated account suddenly moving significant value is a mule/takeover pattern.
rules.explanation: An account anomaly combined with an elevated value raises the risk to HIGH.

rules.name: Elevated value at high velocity
rules.description: High-value payments at high velocity indicate cash-out behaviour.
rules.explanation: High transaction frequency combined with an elevated value raises the risk to HIGH.

rules.name: Session hijack on trusted device
rules.description: A trusted device with a high-risk login and a large payment suggests a hijacked session. Analyst review is warranted.
rules.explanation: A trusted device paired with a high-risk login and an elevated value raises the risk to HIGH and escalates to analyst review.

rules.name: Accumulation of weak signals
rules.description: Three or more independent indicators together indicate a materially elevated risk even if no specific pair rule matches.
rules.explanation: Three or more independent risk indicators raise the risk to HIGH.

rules.name: High risk, off-hours, new location
rules.description: A high-risk transaction made off-hours from an unfamiliar location is a strong takeover signal.
rules.explanation: A HIGH-risk conclusion combined with off-hours activity and a new location escalates to CRITICAL.

rules.name: High risk with authentication anomaly at high velocity
rules.description: Rapid payments after anomalous authentication indicate active exploitation of a compromised account.
rules.explanation: A HIGH-risk conclusion combined with an authentication anomaly and high velocity escalates to CRITICAL.

rules.name: Account takeover pattern
rules.description: A dormant/reactivated account with anomalous login on an unverified device is the canonical account-takeover signature.
rules.explanation: An account anomaly, an authentication anomaly and an unverified device together indicate account takeover and escalate to CRITICAL.

rules.name: Multiple strong risk indicators
rules.description: Five or more independent indicators leave little doubt that the transaction is anomalous.
rules.explanation: Five or more independent risk indicators escalate the risk to CRITICAL.

rules.name: Trusted device in familiar location
rules.description: A trusted device, a familiar location and an active account are strong evidence of genuine behaviour. This is mitigating evidence only: it never overrides a higher risk conclusion.
rules.explanation: A trusted device in a familiar location on an active account supports a LOW classification.
